name: cavemio-date-range-picker
title: Date range picker
description: A range is one liquid band: it follows your pointer between days, presets flow it to their span, and the dates morph as it moves.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The pill is a button with aria-haspopup="dialog"; the days are a grid of gridcells with full spoken dates, aria-selected for the range and aria-current for today.
- Arrows move a day or a week, Home and End go to the week’s ends, Page Up and Page Down change month, Enter or Space picks; Escape closes and returns focus to the pill.
- Choosing a range announces it through a polite status region; the rolling count is hidden from assistive tech.
- The panel is a popover inside the component (no portal), so give its container room or let it overflow; it nudges itself sideways to stay 12px inside the viewport.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion the band, the dots and the panel change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: – · The applied range, controlled or not. onValueChange runs on Apply.

props.name: presets
props.description: DATE_RANGE_PRESETS · Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month, Last month, This year. Pass [] for a calendar on its own.

props.name: min / max
props.description: – · Days outside them are dimmed and can’t be picked; the month arrows stop at them.

props.name: unit
props.description: "days" · What the footer counts. Nights need at least one, so the same day twice doesn’t end a range.

props.name: locales
props.description: "en-GB" · For the dates, the month and the weekday letters.

props.name: align
props.description: "start" · Line the panel up with the pill’s left or right edge; it shifts to stay on screen either way.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: – · Whether the panel is open; controlled or not.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: "Pick dates" · The pill’s label before a range is set.

useCases.title: Analytics dashboards
useCases.description: Filter charts by Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month or any range in between.

useCases.title: Booking and travel
useCases.description: Choose check-in and check-out dates, with the nights counted for you.

useCases.title: Reports and exports
useCases.description: Pick the period a report or a CSV export should cover.

useCases.title: Invoices and audit logs
useCases.description: Narrow a long list to the dates that matter.

features.title: A range in two taps
features.description: Tap a day, move to the day you want to end on and the band stretches after you. Tap again and it is set.

features.title: Presets built in
features.description: Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month, Last month and This year. Pass your own, or none for a calendar on its own.

features.title: Days or nights
features.description: Count days for analytics, or nights for stays, where at least one night is needed. Set min and max to rule days out.

features.title: A live summary
features.description: The footer’s dates morph as the band moves and the day count rolls.

features.title: Keyboard and spoken dates
features.description: Arrows move by a day or a week, Page Up and Down change month, and every day has its full date for screen readers.

features.title: Fits narrow screens
features.description: In a narrow panel the presets become a row of chips, and the panel nudges itself to stay inside the viewport.

states.title: open / close
states.description: The panel’s clip eases from a pill-sized strip under the trigger to its full size (440ms) while it fades in; Cancel, Escape or a tap outside folds it back (240ms) and focus returns to the pill.

states.title: first day
states.description: A dot pops onto the day (scale 0.5→1, 300ms, a slight overshoot); the band shows lighter while the range is open.

states.title: preview
states.description: Each week row is one band that eases its left edge and width to the days in range (340ms), rounding fully where the range starts or ends; the end dot glides day to day and the footer’s range morphs and its count rolls.

states.title: presets
states.description: The highlight slides to the preset (380ms) and the band flows to its span; a custom range fades the highlight out where it was. In a narrow panel the presets become a row of chips that scrolls the chosen one into view.

states.title: month
states.description: ‹ and ›, Page Up/Down, or arrowing past the edge slide the days in 20px from that side out of a 4px blur (380ms); the title morphs.

states.title: apply
states.description: The pill’s label morphs to the new range as the panel folds back into it.
